searchText: Given the very high number of nodes on the network, i dont see this as a problem at all <@194432762315407360> reading your arguments, i believe they make sense. we just need to make sure that `earliestBlock`, doesnt always mean a real earliest block. meaning, if a node declares merge block as `earliestBlock` in eth protocol, it could still be participating in etha protocol and have earlier shards than that `earliestBlock`. if that is okay with everyone, then we can proceed with that. yeah that was the idea! the `earliestBlock` is supposed to be the earliest block for which history is served **by eth protocol**
